parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to query user groups.
 >You can call the [DescribeInstances ](~~462953~~)operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.
Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to query user groups.
> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~462924~~).

parameters.name: UserGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the user group that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-user-groups --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --user-group-name TestGroup01 --region cn-hangzhou
